children: Sen.
Elizabeth Warren

(D-Mass.) called for a sweeping ban on stock trading by senior government officials, arguing that the president and members of Congress should serve the public rather than their personal investment portfolios.
Warren Says Trump Outtraded Congress
On Saturday, in a post on X, Warren said, "The President vs. every member of Congress COMBINED. Guess who made more personal financial trades? Donald Trump — with 28,000+ trades."
She added, "Stock trading by top government officials should be illegal—no owning, buying, or selling stocks."

In the accompanying video, Warren argued that the president, vice president, Cabinet officials and members of Congress should be prohibited from trading stocks because they may have access to information unavailable to the public.
"It’s crazy," Warren said, referring to the fact that senior government officials can legally trade stocks while in office.
She pointed to a graph comparing securities trades by the House and Senate with Trump’s reported activity, arguing that his total exceeded the two chambers combined.
Warren Demands Ban on Officials’ Stock Trading
"Donald Trump and every member of Congress should be working for the American people, not for their own personal stock portfolio," Warren said.
She concluded by calling for a comprehensive prohibition, saying, "It is time to ban this kind of thing once and for all."
